FORMAT LAW. Honour the grammar of the impossible parkour loop — its native framing, its edit rhythm, and the specific thing audiences expect from it. If the format loops, the last frame must match the first.

CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a slow dolly-in that closes about a third of the distance on a 58mm vintage double-gauss, framing with a shallow out-of-focus foreground element occluding the lower third.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with an overcast soft dome with no directional shadow at all; grade as warm amber highlights rolling into cool slate shadows. Specify the sound design in one clause — what the viewer hears in the first second decides whether they stay.

OUTPUT. Emit one prompt, one paragraph, no framing text of any kind before or after it.
